Household impact examples: the household API's answers (net income before and after, by programme, by measure and the earnings sweep, with the marginal rate's parts and net income's parts by programme at each sweep point) for the eight example households (pensioner-70, pensioner-full-state-pension, carer, saver, family-uc, landlord-saver, landlord-45k, bus-commuter), each with every answer fixed in src/utils/householdExamples.js, and the eight published Autumn Budget 2026 measures selected (with the £2 bus fare cap, bus_fare_cap_2027), plus the two the calculator always adds (the savings income tax rise, savings_income_rates_up, and the cash ISA limit kept at £20,000, cash_isa_limit_kept), for 2027-28 to 2031-32. Hypothetical households; no survey records, ids or weights. Regenerated on 30 October 2026 (#361) for the cash ISA limit kept at £20,000, all 40 entries, by scripts/precompute_household_presets.py's own calculation run locally on policyengine 6.11.1 (policyengine-uk 2.151.0, policyengine-core 3.33.3, uk_budget_data 0.1.0), not by the test household API, so no entry records a git_sha. Compared entry by entry with the 29 October file (sha256 a025c166dff997a55ce8ae0969d2bfe8125c58dabb948b86766f2e92c634dac7): no example pays into a cash ISA, so every figure is unchanged; each entry differs only in listing the cash ISA limit among its requested and included measures, with a zero line for it in the split by policy.

Percentiles (1st to 99th) of equivalised household net income, person-weighted, before and after each of the 7 announced measures and the 7-measure package, by year (2026-2031), from release 296e1278 (freeze 4de166f0; policyengine 6.11.1, policyengine-uk 2.151.0, the bundle's certified Microcosm a6299504). Each point is the person-weighted mean income of a band around the percentile, never one household's own figure, and a band with fewer than 100 survey households is left out (calculators.DISTRIBUTION_MIN_HOUSEHOLDS). No minimum or maximum. No area below the UK.

Income mobility: the share of people moving up, down or not at all in the person-weighted income distribution, by starting decile and for everyone, by percentile and by decile, for each of the 7 announced measures and the 7-measure package, 2026-2031, from release 296e1278 (freeze 4de166f0; policyengine 6.11.1, policyengine-uk 2.151.0, the bundle's certified Microcosm a6299504). A share of movers is published only when they come from at least 10 survey households (calculators.MOBILITY_MIN_HOUSEHOLDS). No area below the UK.

Growth across the distribution with each measure: real median equivalised HBAI income (BHC and AHC, 2027-28 prices) by quintile, decile and vigintile (vigintile 1 left out), for all people and non-pensioners, under each of the 7 announced measures and the 7-measure package and each run's own baseline, 2027-28 to 2031-32, from release 296e1278 (freeze 4de166f0; policyengine 6.11.1, policyengine-uk 2.151.0, the bundle's certified Microcosm a6299504). A grouping is published for a run only if every cell on both sides has at least 100 unweighted households. Group medians only; no ids, weights or counts. No area below the UK.
